utterances.text: All right. We're going on to a much different chapter at this point. Would you like us to bring up a map to -- we did not get to -- we just made a cut at Luke and Kladanj and Tuzla in our site visit. We just thought it was too much. But we do have the map book that will help us identify that. Yes, and ...

utterances.speaker: JUDGE FLUEGGE
utterances.text: If you could call up such a map now on the screen, that would be helpful. If not, we have received several maps already, in the map book especially.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Yes, I have a very simple to-scale map book. It's at P54. It's at P75, not P54. This is page 5 of your map book, which -- if we could blow that up a bit. And I think we can bring it down so we can just see Kladanj. Keep going. You'll get Tuzla up in the top screen. Keep going, keep going, there we go.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: So I know those -- for some reason, they didn't scan very well, but can you trace the route on this, if you know it? And I think we might as well use the -- I think we can use the pen on this. Where -- let's start in Bratunac where -- well, we can start in Potocari. And hopefully, if you just start in Potocari, you can just draw the line along the road where they went.

utterances.speaker: ERIN GALLAGHER [Resumed]
utterances.text: In terms of in the buses, like, Potocari, Bratunac ...

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Yeah, just -- just trace the road where they went, actually, with the -- on the -- yeah, there we go.

utterances.speaker: ERIN GALLAGHER [Resumed]
utterances.text: Mm-hmm. Okay. And then from Bratunac to Konjevic Polje, down to Milici.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Okay.

utterances.speaker: ERIN GALLAGHER [Resumed]
utterances.text: Towards Vlasenica.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Okay. And --

utterances.speaker: ERIN GALLAGHER [Resumed]
utterances.text: And then up to Tisca. And then the route to Luke.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Now, Luke, is that where they were dropped off?

utterances.speaker: ERIN GALLAGHER [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: And that purple line at Luke, is that -- what's that?

utterances.speaker: ERIN GALLAGHER [Resumed]
utterances.text: The confrontation line.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Okay. So then they would have walked across that confrontation line, and --

utterances.speaker: ERIN GALLAGHER [Resumed]
utterances.text: Right.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: -- met people roughly at the other side of the confrontation line; is that right?

utterances.speaker: ERIN GALLAGHER [Resumed]
utterances.text: Correct.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Okay. And then we can see that the distance Tuzla is and the map book is actually to scale for each square, and it's roughly -- it's about 5 kilometres from Potocari to Bratunac, so you can just use that to get an idea of how far it is from Kladanj to Tuzla as the crow flies. It's clearly at least 50 kilometres. But that gives you a better picture of the Kladanj front line Luke-Tuzla area which we just, frankly, did not think we had enough time to see.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE FLUEGGE
utterances.text: Are you tendering this map?

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Excuse me, Mr. President, I -- this map book, I believe, came in and was discussed in detail with Mr. Ruez, and I understand it's a long time ago. I don't remember exactly --

utterances.speaker: JUDGE FLUEGGE
utterances.text: This was not my question. If you are tendering this marked map --

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Oh, of course. Yes, I'm sorry. I'm sorry. Thank you.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE FLUEGGE
utterances.text: To have a better understanding of the transcript.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Yes, absolutely. And this -- this route is important.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE FLUEGGE
utterances.text: It will be received. The marking map will be received. And Judge Nyambe wants to put a question in relation to this map.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE NYAMBE
utterances.text: Actually, it's not a question. Do you think you could mark the confrontation line -- it's gone. Can you mark the confrontation line when you next mark the route. Okay?

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Yes, I think we can --

utterances.speaker: JUDGE FLUEGGE
utterances.text: The number of the marked map.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: The markings made by the witness, Your Honours, on P00075 will be assigned P01261.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: And could we get another colour and, just so it's very clear, where the confrontation line is.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE FLUEGGE
utterances.text: Is it possible to get the marked map back on the screen, P1261, please.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Thank you.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE FLUEGGE
utterances.text: There it is again. Judge Nyambe.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE NYAMBE
utterances.text: You can just put an X.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: It's not showing up. It's a bit off there. But where you can see the purple line that's coming down, where it intersects the road there.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE NYAMBE
utterances.text: Thank you.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: So can we just be clear. It's a little hard to tell. The purple line that goes north/south and goes all the way through this, is that the confrontation line?

utterances.speaker: ERIN GALLAGHER [Resumed]
utterances.text: That's the confrontation line, yeah.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Okay.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE FLUEGGE
utterances.text: This should be admitted into evidence as well so that we have a full picture.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Yes, please.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: Can I just note that my -- my X, for whatever reasons, went to the right side of the line. It is supposed to be right on the line there.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: So why don't we just erase that and just --

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: Thank you.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: -- yeah, do it again. Thanks.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: [Marks]

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Okay. Then we'd offer --

utterances.speaker: JUDGE FLUEGGE
utterances.text: Thank you. We will admit that into evidence.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: All right --

utterances.speaker: JUDGE FLUEGGE
utterances.text: One moment.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: Your Honours, the markings made on Exhibit P01261 will be assigned Exhibit P01262.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE FLUEGGE
utterances.text: Mr. McCloskey.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Now, if we could go back up to just, in the movie, it's at -- it says -- it should start: "Potocari, 13 July 1995, Petrovic footage." And it's at 02.21.19.3.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Now, can you just tell us briefly --

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Because we will be hearing from Mr. Petrovic; we will be hearing from Mr. Blaszczyk, who has studied this and will be able to give us locations actually seen on the video. Ms. Gallagher will help us with still IDs of people in it, but it's a -- as you'll find, a very interesting video with lots of -- lots of questions may arise. She can answer some of them, but we do have Mr. Petrovic coming and Mr. Blaszczyk. So we'll somewhat awkwardly try to give you the guts of this, but be prepared for more detail as it comes.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: So, first of all, can you tell us, when we say "Petrovic video," what do we mean by that, "Petrovic footage"?

utterances.speaker: ERIN GALLAGHER [Resumed]
utterances.text: Zoran Petrovic was an independent journalist from Belgrade, and he was attached to the Special Police, to Ljubomir Borovcanin, on July 13th. He followed him on that day, as well as actually July 14th, and took this footage. He is the only person that is with Borovcanin. He's doing his own camera work. And he spends the day with him. The footage is then sold to many different places around the world. It's very famous footage, and you'll see it over and over again. And this is his -- his video footage.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: And can you tell us the areas -- just roughly, the areas that it -- that we're going to be seeing in this footage?

utterances.speaker: ERIN GALLAGHER [Resumed]
utterances.text: It starts out in Potocari, so you'll see them in Potocari on the 13th. And then it goes to the road between Konjevic Polje and Kravica, along that road, and Sandici meadow. Then there's a little bit of footage on the 14th in Srebrenica.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: And in that original footage that got sold and sent out around the world that the OTP got a copy of, was that the complete video that was at the time?

utterances.speaker: ERIN GALLAGHER [Resumed]
utterances.text: No. It was the -- most of the footage -- but also we had discovered that -- earlier Srebrenica teams had discovered that there was some missing portions of the footage that was not given to us by Zoran Petrovic, and it's specifically some footage of men in the "White House" in Potocari, as well as bodies seen in the Kravica warehouse. Both of these on July 13th.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: And when you see the original footage, is there anything indicating a blackout or an overcover or something where the pieces have been cut from?

utterances.speaker: ERIN GALLAGHER [Resumed]
utterances.text: In the video footage that Zoran Petrovic gave us, these bits that I mentioned, the "White House" and the Kravica warehouse, in place of those bits are -- is a -- is some taped-over bits. One of them is of some ammunition. Another one is of food MRE box. There's another section that's in black where he is apparently having a conversation with his family in his apartment.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: All right. And he explains this in his testimony?

utterances.speaker: ERIN GALLAGHER [Resumed]
utterances.text: He does.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: All right. And when you say "food MRE," can you tell us what that is?

utterances.speaker: ERIN GALLAGHER [Resumed]
utterances.text: They are the ready-to-eat military food boxes that they get out in the field.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: And did we some time later receive more footage, missing footage, if you will, from this Petrovic video?

utterances.speaker: ERIN GALLAGHER [Resumed]
utterances.text: We did later receive the missing footage. It was actually broadcasted on -- in Belgrade on their independent TV station called Studio B.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: And so can you now just remind us what, briefly, the missing footage is?

utterances.speaker: ERIN GALLAGHER [Resumed]
utterances.text: There's two major portions that are missing. One of them is of the men that are being -- that are on the balcony at the "White House" in Potocari, that are being held there. And then the other footage is in front of the Kravica warehouse. There's a number of bodies laying in front of the warehouse. And there's several men also in front of the warehouse, whether they're police or Bosnian Serb officers that are in front of the warehouse.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: All right. And we'll -- and does the video, as its played for the Court, will that distinguish the original sometimes and then go back and show the little missing pieces?

utterances.speaker: ERIN GALLAGHER [Resumed]
utterances.text: Correct. You'll see where it's -- the missing portions are placed in by Marta Fracassetti. And one of the obvious things that you'll notice is that it will say "Studio B." There's an emblem for them, for Studio B, in the corner of the -- of the footage.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: All right. And to try to save a little time, there are several stills of the Petrovic footage that identify various members of the Bratunac Brigade and some PJP or MUP officers; is that correct?

utterances.speaker: ERIN GALLAGHER [Resumed]
utterances.text: That's correct.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: And have you reviewed the still book in that situation to confirm those -- those IDs are correct?

utterances.speaker: ERIN GALLAGHER [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, they're all correct.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: And for the record, that would be pages 67, 68, and 69 of the still book. And page 70 of the still book is of an APC, Bratunac Brigade APC.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Were you able to identify that as a Bratunac Brigade APC? I don't think we need to show it all at this point.

utterances.speaker: ERIN GALLAGHER [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, I checked the vehicle logs, and this APC is registered for the Bratunac Brigade.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: And that's, for the record, on pages 70 and 71 of the still book.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: And on page 72 was a Bratunac Brigade TAM rocket-launcher that was also identified by Mr. Butler as the military analyst in this case as belonging to the Bratunac Brigade; is that correct.

utterances.speaker: ERIN GALLAGHER [Resumed]
utterances.text: Correct, he testified in Krstic that that was a -- that was a TAM rocket-launcher registered to the Bratunac Brigade.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Okay.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: And if we could go to, now, page 73. There's a significant person who is a bit more significant than these mere soldiers to this case, so I would like it if you could see that. And then I'll just try to play the film so we don't have interruptions. If we could get to page 73 in that still book P624.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: And this person has been identified as Mendeljev Djuric, 1st Company commander Special Police brigade, Jahorina training centre. Is that correct?

utterances.speaker: ERIN GALLAGHER [Resumed]
utterances.text: That's correct.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: When it says "identified himself at trial," which trial was that?

utterances.speaker: ERIN GALLAGHER [Resumed]
utterances.text: That was in the Popovic trial in May 2007. He identified himself.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: All right. And that is a -- Your Honours, a straight 92 bis witness at this point, number 120. So he will not be called, unless the Defence calls him or the Court chooses to. All right. I think at this point we can just play this -- this -- the Petrovic footage for the Potocari segment. And, of course, if anyone has any questions, please let us know. You have seen some of this before, I think, through Major Kingori. We start at 02.21.19.3.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Has the investigation identified who we can hear talking?

utterances.speaker: ERIN GALLAGHER [Resumed]
utterances.text: We heard just there -- you'll hear Zoran Petrovic and usually Ljubisa Borovcanin.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Okay. And we can -- and that was at 02.22.02.1.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Again, have any of these --

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Have any of these men been identified as gone missing from Potocari on July 13th, 1995?

utterances.speaker: ERIN GALLAGHER [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes. There's a number of these men that have passed by that we know the identity of who they are. And I think most of the men that are seen here, if not all of them, have been identified from mass graves.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: And that will be the subject of another book on another day?

utterances.speaker: ERIN GALLAGHER [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Okay.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Thank you, we can continue.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: And we're at 02.24.12.6.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: And can you tell us who's asking the questions of these people?

utterances.speaker: ERIN GALLAGHER [Resumed]
utterances.text: That's the journalist Zoran Petrovic that is asking questions.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: And, Your Honours, the transcript, of course, is available. And these people that we know are identified, of course, in the transcript. But I think just to -- for the showing, to make it clear.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE FLUEGGE
utterances.text: Is it the transcript P1008?

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Exactly.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE FLUEGGE
utterances.text: Thank you.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: We just see, at 02.26.21.9, that we have a time and date stamped. It just appeared. Has the investigation reviewed that for correctness?

utterances.speaker: ERIN GALLAGHER [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, it has. That is the correct date and time based on our knowledge of events, based on statements. And Zoran Petrovic himself verified that that was correct.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Thank you. We can continue.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE FLUEGGE
utterances.text: Can we stop for a moment. Judge Nyambe.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE NYAMBE
utterances.text: Just a clarification. We saw just in blue berets seen in this video are UN soldiers?

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: That's correct, they are UN DutchBat soldiers.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE NYAMBE
utterances.text: Thank you.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: And the person -- perhaps we could go back just a little bit. And we are stilled here at 02.26.36.0.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: This person in the blue, do you know who that is?

utterances.speaker: ERIN GALLAGHER [Resumed]
utterances.text: That's Lieutenant van Duijn from the DutchBat.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Has he always been a witness and testified about the events that we see him in here?

utterances.speaker: ERIN GALLAGHER [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, he's testified before about this and identified himself in this video.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: And he is a 92 bis, with cross, so we hope to be seeing him, Your Honour, so that we will get a much clearer picture of what's going on, what's being said, and who all these people are, from a direct source.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE FLUEGGE
utterances.text: In your question, you said the man in blue. You were referring to the beret?

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Yes, absolutely. That's, I think, the only blue thing about him. With the blue beret, yes.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE FLUEGGE
utterances.text: Thank you. Just for clarification. Please carry on.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: At 02.27.50.1, the man in the blue beret and the T-shirt, who is that?

utterances.speaker: ERIN GALLAGHER [Resumed]
utterances.text: Once again, it's Lieutenant van Duijn.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: And we see the back of the person he is speak to, but do you know, from seeing this video, the entire thing, who that is?

utterances.speaker: ERIN GALLAGHER [Resumed]
utterances.text: And that's Ljubisa Borovcanin of the Special Police.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Okay. Thank you.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Just to remind us, can you now get a better look at who this -- this black man is with the blue beret?

utterances.speaker: ERIN GALLAGHER [Resumed]
utterances.text: That's Colonel Joseph Kingori.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Thank you.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: We can continue.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: I just want to ask you, on this entire video, is there anyone else besides, at that time, Major Kingori that can be seen actually saying something, complaining about the conditions for the Muslim population?

utterances.speaker: ERIN GALLAGHER [Resumed]
utterances.text: My recollection is he's the only one.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Okay. Thank you.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: We can continue.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Looking at this still at 02.29.58.3, I think we will all agree we see Major Kingori. And that, actually, is on page 77 of the still book, but I don't think we need it at this point. Actually, let's -- let's go to that now, if we could. Page 77 of the still book.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: I think we now can recognise Major Kingori and Mr. Borovcanin as 2 and 3 respectively. Number 4 is only identified as Miki. How is this -- do you remember how this identification was made?

utterances.speaker: ERIN GALLAGHER [Resumed]
utterances.text: It was made by Mendeljev Djuric, and he did not remember his full name. He had the nickname of Miki and that he was a member of the deserter Jahorina unit of the Special Police.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: And I think I recall that Colonel Kingori, at the time when he testified here, had stated he thought number 1 was a VRS soldier. We see number 1 as the investigative team identifying as a member of the United Nations Dutch Battalion. Is the investigations correct on this, in your view?

utterances.speaker: ERIN GALLAGHER [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, we haven't identified who he is. I certainly know from the interview that Ljubisa Borovcanin gave us, and he watched this video and identified people, he did not identify him as a Bosnian Serb officer or soldier.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: All right.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: And I think it's break time.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE FLUEGGE
utterances.text: Yes, it is. We must have our second break now, and we will resume at 1.00.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE FLUEGGE
utterances.text: Mr. McCloskey, before we adjourn today, the Chamber needs five to seven minutes for some housekeeping matters at the end of today's session.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Fine. We'll, I'm sure, remember that, with Ms. Stewart's help. And I think we're -- I think we're ready just to continue playing the Petrovic video from 13 July.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: We just saw what appeared to be a big brass shell casing of some sort. Does this fit into what you told us earlier about this film?

utterances.speaker: ERIN GALLAGHER [Resumed]
utterances.text: Right. The footage that Zoran Petrovic had given us had the section, where you saw the beginning of it, of the casing, the ammunition. And what you then saw was the footage of Studio B that we believe to be -- was originally in that spot.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Okay. That shell casing sitting there, is there any way to tie that -- a shell casing just sitting there into Potocari in any way?

utterances.speaker: ERIN GALLAGHER [Resumed]
utterances.text: Right, obviously it doesn't -- it doesn't -- especially when you see the full footage, it doesn't make logical sense.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: And so now we're beginning this what you call Studio B. Can you reminds us what Studio B is?

utterances.speaker: ERIN GALLAGHER [Resumed]
utterances.text: It's an independent TV station in Belgrade who aired the Petrovic footage with the original bits in it such as the section you are about to see from the "White House" in Potocari.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: And this writing that goes along the bottom of the screen - I think it even advertises a Rolling Stones concert - what's that?

utterances.speaker: ERIN GALLAGHER [Resumed]
utterances.text: I only presume it was -- it was -- I think because this was taped off of the TV, so it was what was shown on TV at that time.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: And can you remind us what we're about to see on Studio B that we didn't see on original Petrovic?

utterances.speaker: ERIN GALLAGHER [Resumed]
utterances.text: What you're about to see is a close-up of the "White House" of the balcony, the front balcony. You'll see the men that are sitting in the balcony.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Okay. Can you tell if they're sitting or standing?

utterances.speaker: ERIN GALLAGHER [Resumed]
utterances.text: You see them sitting, looking out towards the camera.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: All right. Let's see that. And continue to play it.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: I've just frozen it at 02.30.43.1.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Is this what you are talking about?

utterances.speaker: ERIN GALLAGHER [Resumed]
utterances.text: Correct.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Okay. I think we can continue it.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: We just saw the oversound said that these people were registered war criminals. Have you -- has the investigation uncovered any indication that all those men on that balcony are registered war criminals?

utterances.speaker: ERIN GALLAGHER [Resumed]
utterances.text: No. What witnesses have said is that men were separated and taken -- and taken up to the "White House." And a number of them have stated that they -- that there were men that were executed.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: All right. I think that we can continue.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Okay. Now we are at 02.31.19.0.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: We are now -- it says "Potocari 13 July 1995." Just before we get to this, does the Petrovic video continue after what we just saw?

utterances.speaker: ERIN GALLAGHER [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, it does. So this portion is placed in between the Petrovic video.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: And because this is in Potocari, we're staying in Potocari for a while?

utterances.speaker: ERIN GALLAGHER [Resumed]
utterances.text: Correct.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Okay. How do you know, if you can recall, that this Dutch Battalion footage was 13 July? Perhaps we can watch it and see if -- see if you know that answer, otherwise we'll put that on the homework list. And Dutch Battalion soldier, what -- what can you tell us about that?

utterances.speaker: ERIN GALLAGHER [Resumed]
utterances.text: This is, once again, the footage that we got from Antelope Productions, and they received it from this DutchBat warrant officer Wim Dijkema.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: All right. Let's play this then.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Now, seeing this at 02.31.55.2, does this -- do you now recall, you know, what this footage is? I think it goes on for several minutes, and we may be able to save some time.

utterances.speaker: ERIN GALLAGHER [Resumed]
utterances.text: It's refugees being placed inside the buses in Potocari, and then you will see all the buses leaving.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: All right. And that's pretty much what it is for many minutes, and I think we saw this through Mr. Ruez, so I think Ms. Stewart can bump it ahead a bit. Okay. Now we're back to the Petrovic video at 02.37.45.0. And it says "On the Road, 13 July 1995."

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: So again, remind us, when we say "on the road," what are we talking about?

utterances.speaker: ERIN GALLAGHER [Resumed]
utterances.text: This is the road from Bratunac to Konjevic Polje. And the next scene, it will be -- you'll see is in Sandici meadow.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: All right. And the various scenes that are along the road, has that been the subject of an actual 'nother exhibit done by another investigator in the case?

utterances.speaker: ERIN GALLAGHER [Resumed]
utterances.text: Correct. My colleague Tomasz Blaszczyk will, in more detail - there he is - created a road book, and there's some video presentation that will show -- parallel the photographs and the video in the exact locations along the road and also in Potocari.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: All right. So are your basic identifications of places in part based on Mr. -- well, the investigator that did this?

utterances.speaker: ERIN GALLAGHER [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yeah, it's certainly based on his work, as well as my travels and experience along the road as well.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: All right. I think let's just start to play that then.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Okay. Here we are at 02.38.14.9. Could we go to page 79 in the still book.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Now, this man that is calling out, Ramo Osmanovic, is that correct that he's been confirmed dead from a Zeleni Jadar secondary mass grave?

utterances.speaker: ERIN GALLAGHER [Resumed]
utterances.text: That's correct. And with the primary being Glogova and the execution site being Kravica warehouse.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: And the actual grave-site, will that be identified in Mr. Janc's report for him?

utterances.speaker: ERIN GALLAGHER [Resumed]
utterances.text: Correct.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: And it is correct that he was identified by his wife?

utterances.speaker: ERIN GALLAGHER [Resumed]
utterances.text: Correct.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Okay. Now we see number 2 is a person in -- with a camouflage outfit on named Slobodan Petrovic, a member of the 1st Company PJP. And he was identified by Svetlan Stanisic in an OTP interview; is that correct?

utterances.speaker: ERIN GALLAGHER [Resumed]
utterances.text: That's correct. And Svetlan Stanisic is also a member of the PJP.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Now, I think I'll try to save some time, but let's go to one more still that we've seen part of. It's page 80.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: This is the person we see giving Ramo instructions. And is that identification of him, as Milenko, Cop, Trifunovic, as a member of the Special Police brigade 2nd Sekovici Detachment MUP; is that all correct?

utterances.speaker: ERIN GALLAGHER [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, that's correct.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: As -- we can see from the video it's a bit fuzzy, but he, Trifunovic, identified himself?

utterances.speaker: ERIN GALLAGHER [Resumed]
utterances.text: He did, in the October 2002 interview.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Have you made -- has the investigation and yourself made an effort to identify the other people in camouflage uniforms that are seen along the road and around Sandici meadow and the next pages?

utterances.speaker: ERIN GALLAGHER [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, we have.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: And what units are, primarily, those people identified from?

utterances.speaker: ERIN GALLAGHER [Resumed]
utterances.text: Primarily, that they're all police. And they are members from the Sekovici Special Police brigade; members of the PJP, the separate police units; as well as the deserter Jahorina unit, also under the Special Police brigade.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: All right. And just for the record, page -- those identifications can be found on pages 81, 82, in part 83, 86, 87, 88, 89, 90, 91, 92, 93, 94, 97, 98, 99, 100, 101, 102.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: And, in addition, will the video show Pragas or these anti-aircraft guns shooting up at the -- towards the -- where the Muslims are surrendering?

utterances.speaker: ERIN GALLAGHER [Resumed]
utterances.text: Correct. You'll see them shooting into the hills. Into the -- where the men are walking.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: And have you been able to identify what units those anti-aircraft weapons were attached to?

utterances.speaker: ERIN GALLAGHER [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, they were the Sekovici Brigade, Praga and BOV.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: All right. And there's also a shot of a tank as well along -- it's page 96, we don't need to go there, I don't think. Do you remember if that was identified to any specific unit?

utterances.speaker: ERIN GALLAGHER [Resumed]
utterances.text: A number of witnesses have said that that tank from Sekovici was placed down towards Konjevic Polje. In terms of identifying that exact tank, we have not had anyone say that that specific one is Sekovici.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: All right.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: And I think we can just play the video, and I may stop it at a point or two to clarify anything. And, of course, Your Honours, please feel free to do that as well.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Here we are at 02.38.31.8.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: We here him, Ramo, calling, "Nermine [phoen]." Do you know who that is, Nermine?

utterances.speaker: ERIN GALLAGHER [Resumed]
utterances.text: Nermin is his son.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: And was his son, do you know, found anywhere?

utterances.speaker: ERIN GALLAGHER [Resumed]
utterances.text: He was found in Hadzici, so he would have come from Orahovac and been executed in Orahovac.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: All right. Let's continue.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: What is this blackened part where there's conversation?

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: It's Zoran Petrovic speaking. And his -- his testimony was that he had the lens cap over the camera and he was taping. And he's at his home with his family. And I think he was saying he was on -- he was having a telephone conversation.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: And did the investigation fit a missing piece into this section?

utterances.speaker: ERIN GALLAGHER [Resumed]
utterances.text: I don't think into this particular section.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Okay.

utterances.speaker: ERIN GALLAGHER [Resumed]
utterances.text: Not the piece -- not a piece we found, anyway.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: All right.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE FLUEGGE
utterances.text: Stop for a moment. Judge Mindua.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MINDUA
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Mr. McCloskey, I apologise, I fear we might move on to another footage, so I would like to put the question now. Witness, on page 63 of the transcript, line 19, you talk about shots in the direction of the hills. It's difficult for me to see who was firing these shots. Do you know who was firing these shots, and do you know whether there was any retaliation or shots in response?

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: The footage referred to is a little bit further down. You'll see, coming up, and it's the Praga that's shooting up into the hills, into the -- to the men, the wood walkers, that are walking through. The -- in fact, Paras Stupar [phoen], the aimer for the Praga, has stated that it was his Praga that was shooting up; he was ordered by Ljubisa Borovcanin to shoot towards them for the cameras. And, no, you won't -- you won't hear or see any retaliation.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MINDUA
utterances.text: Right, I accept your answer for the time being. Thank you.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: The soldiers with the guns, who was the man standing over them in the last one, just --

utterances.speaker: ERIN GALLAGHER [Resumed]
utterances.text: In this scene or in the last?

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Sorry, in the last one.

utterances.speaker: ERIN GALLAGHER [Resumed]
utterances.text: It's Ljubisa Borovcanin, deputy commander of the Special Police, who is looking at the gun that the two - one's a PJP, and one's a Sekovici brigade member - are showing him.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: And where is this group of men?

utterances.speaker: ERIN GALLAGHER [Resumed]
utterances.text: The men here are in Sandici meadow. And as you saw the pan, commander -- Deputy Commander Borovcanin and the other two men are on the other side of the street from the meadow near the destroyed white house.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: And this is at 02.39.57.5. I think we can continue it.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: And we're now seeing slow motion. Was this just added by the Prosecution to clarify this situation, or is this part of the footage?

utterances.speaker: ERIN GALLAGHER [Resumed]
utterances.text: No, it was added by the -- it was added by the OTP.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: All right. Now, we've gone to a Studio B segment. And do you remember what this is going to be, to give us a preview? Or should we just play it?

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Let's play it.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: So, do you recall -- that was a Studio B. What, if anything, do you recall on that Studio B segment that was not on the original?

utterances.speaker: ERIN GALLAGHER [Resumed]
utterances.text: Only the two dogs. You'll see the man that's sitting there that looks off into the hills when he hears a shot fired. That's on the footage you'll see still. It's on the original Petrovic footage, but not of the dogs.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: So someone cut out the dogs?

utterances.speaker: ERIN GALLAGHER [Resumed]
utterances.text: Presumably, yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Okay. Let's keep playing.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE FLUEGGE
utterances.text: May we stop here. Judge Nyambe.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE NYAMBE
utterances.text: Thank you. At page 66 of the transcript, lines 5 to 7, you have stated: "The men here are in Sandici meadow. And as you saw the pan ... and the other ... men or on the other side of the street from the meadow near the destroyed white house." Can you place the white house, exactly where it is?

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: Yeah, and not to confuse it with the white house in Potocari; that's a completely different one. We've referred to this as the destroyed white house. It is a white house, and it is destroyed. It's a large house right across the street from Sandici meadow.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE NYAMBE
utterances.text: Thank you.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE FLUEGGE
utterances.text: Please continue.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Stopping at 02.41.03.8.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: What are these things?

utterances.speaker: ERIN GALLAGHER [Resumed]
utterances.text: One's a -- one's a Praga, and one's a BOV, Bov.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: And are they the anti-aircraft guns you've been talking about?

utterances.speaker: ERIN GALLAGHER [Resumed]
utterances.text: Correct.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: And what direction are they shooting at?

utterances.speaker: ERIN GALLAGHER [Resumed]
utterances.text: They're shooting up into the -- the -- into the hills, so they're facing towards Konjevic Polje at this point. And we know that the wood-walkers are moving along the ridge up to the upper left there.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: And we saw some smoke detonations into the -- that were in the hills, just in the previous frame. Where those smoke detonations were, is that the area where the Muslims were walking down towards the road?

utterances.speaker: ERIN GALLAGHER [Resumed]
utterances.text: Correct. A number of, you know, many, many surrender and walk down towards -- towards the road, towards the back side of that destroyed white house.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: And will we come to a section that was cut out of the original and is in the Studio B segment here on this; do you recall?

utterances.speaker: ERIN GALLAGHER [Resumed]
utterances.text: I don't recall in quite this section.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Okay. Well, let's -- let's play it and see how we do.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Does that refresh your recollection a bit, that Studio B segment; can you explain that, as you remember it?

utterances.speaker: ERIN GALLAGHER [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, I forgot about that bit. I was thinking it's pretty much the same footage that you see on the original Petrovic video, but, yes, they've zoomed in, and you hear Zoran Petrovic speaking over, doing the narrative of what's happening, as you just saw in the subtitles.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Do you remember if you look very closely in that cut out bit behind the smoke whether you can see anything? And if you don't remember, that's fine, we'll just keep going?

utterances.speaker: ERIN GALLAGHER [Resumed]
utterances.text: I'm not sure which you're referring to.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: This Studio B segment that was cut out.

utterances.speaker: ERIN GALLAGHER [Resumed]
utterances.text: Correct. I'm not sure which bit.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: The part we just played. No?

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Okay. We'll just continue playing.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Stopping at 02.43.07.8.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: And I know this isn't your particular area of expertise so if you don't know, no problem, but that music that we start hearing, do you know where that music came -- is coming from?

utterances.speaker: ERIN GALLAGHER [Resumed]
utterances.text: You'll hear other music as well that's coming from the car. I presume that this is perhaps coming from the car as well, though I know it is a bit odd.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: And when you say "the car," do you -- has the investigation determined whose car and who is in that car?

utterances.speaker: ERIN GALLAGHER [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yeah, it's Deputy Commander Borovcanin's car, and they are driving -- they drove from Potocari along the road and -- so that it's -- it's Borovcanin's driver. Borovcanin and Zoran Petrovic are the people in the car.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: And who's filming?

utterances.speaker: ERIN GALLAGHER [Resumed]
utterances.text: Zoran Petrovic is doing the filming.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Thank you.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE FLUEGGE
utterances.text: Maybe stop for a moment. Judge Mindua.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MINDUA
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Yes. Mr. McCloskey, I'm very sorry, once again. I would like to put a question to the witness. Madam, were you able to check with Zoran Petrovic if he found out what was the purpose of this military operation? Because we can hear shots, you said that these shots come from anti-aircraft guns, and we can also hear music in the background. So do you know what the purpose of this operation, or were you able to find that out?

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: And you mean the operation meaning the shooting from the guns right there on the road?

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MINDUA
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Yes, precisely. That's what I'm talking about.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: Not from him. But when I interviewed the aimer for the Praga, what he told me was that they were driving along the road, that Deputy Commander Borovcanin had stopped them, wanted them to stop and to shoot up into the hills and for it to be filmed just, I think, for an effect of, you know, they're -- they're, you know, fighting and, you know, using their -- using their weapons. So it was done for the cameras, just exclusively, this few minutes of shooting.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MINDUA
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Very good. Thank you very much. Judge Nyambe.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE NYAMBE
utterances.text: Just a clarification from Mr. McCloskey. Shall I presume that you will be calling Zoran Petrovic?

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Yes. He testified before, and he is on our list to testify again.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE NYAMBE
utterances.text: Thank you.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE FLUEGGE
utterances.text: Mr. Tolimir.

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Your Honour, the witness said that there is a several-minute scene here in the footage and that this relates to the portion that Zoran Petrovic prepared and edited for his -- for the purpose of his report. Could we please indicate which portion was edited so that there would not be a misunderstanding here, that this is an actual combat being waged.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE FLUEGGE
utterances.text: Mr. McCloskey, could you try to deal with that.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Yes, we've been doing that. The portions where we have Studio B segments that are not in the original are portions that the Prosecution believes were edited out, for some reason, of the original. I thought I made that clear earlier. But when we see a Studio B segment, it's an edited piece. And then after the Studio B segment, we go right back into the regular piece. Sometimes that is not as clear as it could be, but as soon as that Studio B segment, which is a very obviously grainy thing with the bottom on it, as soon as that disappears, we are back to the regular one. So that's the way to tell the part that we believe is -- was clearly edited from the original.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE FLUEGGE
utterances.text: Does that help you, Mr. Tolimir?

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Thank you, Mr. President. From 2.40.31 all the way to 02.45.00 we can see that they are driving along the road and we can hear the music in the background, and the witness said that this portion was edited for the purpose of Petrovic's report. So can we ask the witness to actually confirm that and confirm from which point to which point on the footage this is recorded so that it's in the record.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE FLUEGGE
utterances.text: Mr. McCloskey.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: I don't fully understand what the General says. She did not say it was edited. We have a translation issue perhaps. She said that a witness told her it was staged. Whether that's true or not is another question, but -- I'd appreciate it if we could try to avoid that while I am or the Judges are speaking because then the General can't hear me, and he needs to be engaged in this. So I think if he is referring to the part about the witness told her it was staged, I think she can clarify that with him on cross. But for the General, actually edited parts, parts that are taken out, should be made clear by the Studio B segments and the odd or different filming segment so that you understand that's the -- what we believe is edited, and the staged part is something else, that she is, of course, available for on cross-examination.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE FLUEGGE
utterances.text: Thank you very much for that. I think we need to stop the examination of this witness now.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Mr. President, it's 02.46.54.3, Ms. Stewart reminds me -- 02.45.54.3. And we'll start up there. Thank you.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE FLUEGGE
utterances.text: Thank you very much. Ms. Gallagher, again we have to adjourn your examination. And at a later stage I'm sure the Prosecution will call you again. Please be reminded that still you are not permitted to have contact about your evidence to either party. Now you are free to leave the courtroom and -- because I have to discuss some procedural matters. Thank you very much for your attendance.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE FLUEGGE
utterances.text: Recently we have received a list of 26 items of documents which have a translation now, and they are uploaded. The translations are uploaded in e-court. I would like to ask the Registrar to make the necessary notification on the record.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: Thank you, Your Honours. The notification from the Prosecution that the Registry and the Chamber has received are for Prosecution Exhibits P00147, P00151, P00152, P00407B, P00506C, P00506F, P00664B, P00748, P00749, P00753, P00772, P00773A, P00773C, P00810, P00812, P00815, P00828, P00843D, P00850B, P00881, P00953, P00964, P00995, P01011, P01016, P01077.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE FLUEGGE
utterances.text: Thank you very much. The second matter is the following: On the 30th of September, I asked the Prosecution to provide us with hard copies of the videos played in the courtroom. In the mean time, we have received five of them, but there are still some. We would like to receive them. And I would like to remind the Prosecution to provide hard copies of the videos to the Chamber and the Defence as soon as possible after the videos have been played in Court or received into evidence. The third matter has do with the next witness we will hear on Tuesday next week. As you will recall, the Chamber rescinded the witness's protective measures by way of an oral decision on the 10th of September and pointed out that the Krstic transcript remains confidential. The Prosecution advised that it would endeavour to get the record opened up. To date, Prosecution has not revisited this issue. Pursuant to Rule 75(G)(ii), this Chamber is responsible for lifting the confidentiality of that transcript if the Prosecution wishes to raise this problem. Is it your intention, Mr. McCloskey, to have the confidentiality lifted?

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Yes, please, Mr. President.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE FLUEGGE
utterances.text: We will take that into account and come back to that. I take it that this is your oral submission with the aim to lift the confidentiality?

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Yes, Mr. President. I am officially revisiting this issue and would make that a submission, an actual submission, pursuant to your request, so that it's official. Because, as you know, it is an important issue, and I have spoken to the witness and I know that he has no problem with that. So, yes, thank you.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE FLUEGGE
utterances.text: And I take it that has to be done before you call this witness next Tuesday, and I hope we can perhaps deal with that at the beginning of the testimony of that witness next Tuesday. And we can receive an oral response by the Defence on that topic. Thank you very much. I am advised that I forgot to state for the record that the numbers of the documents -- the documents with the numbers read out into the record are now admitted into evidence and no longer marked for identification. Thank you very much. We adjourn and resume next Tuesday in the afternoon, 2.15, in this courtroom. We adjourn. Mr. Gajic, you wanted -- did you want to raise something?

utterances.speaker: MR. GAJIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Your Honours, I didn't want to raise anything, I just wanted to answer a question that you yourself raised. The Defence does not object to rescinding the protective measures from the testimony of the witness that we are going to hear next week, who has already testified in the Krstic case. We do not think that the transcript should be confidential. There are no reasons for that anymore. And in terms of the CD, the Defence has been receiving CDs of the videos that have been admitted into evidence. That has been happening quite regularly. So we don't have any problems with that. Thank you.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE FLUEGGE
utterances.text: Thank you very much. And I apologise, I misunderstood the fact that you were on your feet. I thought you were rising because we adjourn. Thank you very much for this reply. We adjourn.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE FLUEGGE
utterances.text: to be reconvened on Tuesday, the 26th day of October, 2010, at 2.15 p.m. 19 20 21 22 23 24 25
